Proposed next steps:
1) Alex / Priya: confirm preferred questionnaire type and whether a SIG Lite is acceptable.
2) If SIG prefilling is OK, we'll prefill the form and return within ~3 business days; full SIG completion often takes 10–14 business days depending on evidence owners.
3) Book a 30-min kickoff with our Security Ops (Ben) and your security/infra lead to walk data flows and outstanding items.

A few specifics from our security team:
1) SOC 2 status — Do you have an active SOC 2 Type II? If so, who was the auditor and what is the report date? We need both summary and the attestation (NDA ok).
2) Data residency / encryption — which regions is customer data stored in for Hosted? Is customer data encrypted at rest using customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) or platform-managed?
3) PHI handling — you mentioned Dedicated/Private for PHI. Can you confirm if Hosted + BAA is permitted or if PHI must be in Dedicated/Private only?
4) Timeline — if we accept a prefilled SIG Lite, what is realistic turnaround for the prefill and for the full evidence package?
5) If you have a network diagram and a list of evidence artifacts you can attach those now, that would speed things up.

We prefer SIG Lite to start. If you can provide the SOC 2 summary and the network diagram, we can route this internally and book the kickoff.

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Answers below and a proposed evidence path. Quoting the thread for context.

1) SOC 2: We have an active SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2026-11-01 through 2027-04-30). Auditor: Shoreline Audit Partners. We can share the SOC 2 report under an NDA; attached is a 2-page redwood-soc2-summary.pdf that highlights scope and exclusions. (Note: Private / Dedicated deployments are in-scope for the controls; self-hosted on-prem installs are handled case-by-case.)

2) Data residency / encryption: For Hosted API traffic and persisted artifacts (logs, billing metadata), primary storage regions are us-west-2 and us-east-1. Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. For customer-managed keys: Dedicated and Private deployments support customer-managed KMS/HSM. Hosted (standard) uses platform-managed keys but we can arrange Bring-Your-Own-Key for Dedicated.

3) PHI / HIPAA: Redwood will sign a BAA. Our recommended architecture for PHI is Dedicated or Private to isolate tenancy and enable CMK. Hosted with a BAA is possible only on Dedicated capacity; we do not recommend mixing PHI with multi-tenant Hosted instances. 

4) Timeline: If SIG Lite is accepted we can prefill the Lite form within 3 business days (we usually return a prefilling spreadsheet + answers). For a full SIG (and evidence), expect 10–14 business days for the majority of artifacts once ownership is confirmed; items requiring third-party certificates (e.g., pen test reports) may add time.

5) Evidence / attachments: I'm attaching a network-diagram.png and a short evidence checklist (sig-prefill.xlsx). The checklist maps common SIG questions to Redwood artifacts and owners. For items needing NDA-only delivery (full SOC 2), Marissa (cc'd) will coordinate.

Suggested next step: Sofia, if MedIQ confirms SIG Lite, we will:
- Pre-fill SIG Lite answers in sig-prefill.xlsx and upload to your shared link.
- Schedule a 30-min technical kickoff (Ben + Marissa + your infra/security lead).
- Share SOC 2 under NDA; Marissa will send DocuSign for our mutual NDA/secure share if needed.

Happy to hop on a quick call this week if helpful.
